pages.text: [#](53341a)The old **Rite of Summoning** did not call an owl, toad, or cat that already lived in the world. It called a Spectral Familiar — a ghostly companion that seeks out shinies and strange things for its witch.[#]()
pages.title: Spectral Familiar

pages.text: [#](53341a)Feed it an Iron or Gold Ingot, Lapis, Redstone, Coal, an Emerald, or a Diamond. The gift is spent, the familiar searches, and if it finds that ore below it will sit and call out the spot.[#]()
pages.title: Searching for Ores

pages.text: [#](53341a)Repeated searches grow risky: after the first success there is a rising chance the familiar simply vanishes.[#]()
